description.value: Sage Pub & Liquor Store in Osoyoos is a full-service pub-restaurant and attached liquor store serving handmade pizzas, pub favourites, wings, entrees, and a broad takeout menu. It sits in the heart of south Okanagan cycling country and draws a lively local crowd with weekly trivia nights and karaoke. The combination of a kitchen and on-site liquor store makes it a practical resupply and meal stop for touring cyclists passing through town.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sagepub.ca is clearly for the same business — OSM tags it as 'Sage Liquor Store' (shop=alcohol) but the website consistently uses 'Sage Pub & Liquor Store', revealing a combined full-service pub/restaurant and liquor store at 6403 Cottonwood Drive, Osoyoos. The website confirms takeout and delivery service, and the menu lists a Vegetarian pizza, Veggie Platter, and gluten-free pizza crust; no bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere across the fetched pages.
concerns: OSM name is 'Sage Liquor Store' but the website consistently uses 'Sage Pub & Liquor Store' — name updated to match the website per rule 12.
No phone or address present in OSM tags; both values sourced from website only.
19+ only establishment with a two-piece ID requirement — not suitable for cyclists travelling with minors.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service pub-restaurant with takeout in Osoyoos — a major south Okanagan cycling hub — providing food, drink, and liquor resupply that touring cyclists would find genuinely useful.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a Vegetarian pizza, Veggie Platter, and a gluten-free pizza crust option

wow_evidence: full-service pub-restaurant and attached liquor store; takeout and delivery confirmed
